name: benchmark search with capability assessment (Professor Rabczuk, 27 Nov)
approval: Omar, 27 Nov: 'continue everything without stopping'; budget USD 2.5
procedure: code: arXiv queries for established benchmarks, 3D hyperelastic with curved geometry or stress concentration first, then 2D
code: abstract screen, download, passage selection
LLM (autonomous decision): requirements of the example, from a fixed vocabulary (capabilities.REGISTRY)
code (predefined procedure): assessment -> feasible or the list of missing capabilities (NOT implemented); size estimate local / cluster
feasible 2D candidates: carried through by autonomous.run (definition, meshing, MMS, simulation, verification, diagnosis)

predictions.B1_3d_declared: every 3D hyperelastic candidate with curved geometry is declared not feasible, with at least one listed missing capability
predictions.B2_top_gap: the most frequent missing capability is one of: 3D general geometry, nearly incompressible material, 3D problem definition from a paper
predictions.B3_carried_through: at least one candidate is declared feasible and reaches verdicts (numerically verified quantity)
predictions.B4_consistency: no candidate declared feasible is refused by the definition step for a capability that the registry lists as missing
